game.bluff.title: Bluff!
game.bluff.howto.1: Three rounds, three ways to lie: finish a saying, crack an impossible fact, then a final with no truth at all.
game.bluff.howto.2: Write a fake answer on your phone. Know the real ending of the saying? Type it: you score right away.
game.bluff.howto.3: Find the real answer among the fakes. Nobody knows who wrote what until the vote is over.
game.bluff.howto.4: Score twice: +100 for the truth, +60 for every friend who falls for your lie. In the final, the most convincing answer wins big.
game.bluff.rules.goal.title: The goal
game.bluff.rules.goal.body: Fool your friends, and don't get fooled. Best with 4 players or more.
game.bluff.rules.round1.title: Round 1: Finish the saying
game.bluff.rules.round1.body: Type the ending. If your first answer is the real one, you get +150 at once and sit that vote out. If not, your answer becomes a fake on the board.
game.bluff.rules.round2.title: Round 2: Impossible but true
game.bluff.rules.round2.body: A very hard but real fact. Write a fake that sounds truer than the truth. Points ×2.
game.bluff.rules.writing.title: Writing
game.bluff.rules.writing.body: {seconds} s, max 60 characters, in the same alphabet as the prompt. Too close to the real answer? You'll be asked for another one, and finding the truth on that prompt won't score. Stuck? "Help me" suggests a lie (a small fee comes off what it earns).
game.bluff.rules.voting.title: Voting
game.bluff.rules.voting.body: Vote for the answer you think is true, never your own. Like up to 2 answers you find funny.
game.bluff.rules.points.title: Points
game.bluff.rules.points.body: Truth: +100 (round 2: +200). Each player fooled: +60 (round 2: +120). Each like: +10.
game.bluff.rules.final.title: Final: No truth
game.bluff.rules.final.body: There is no right answer. Write the most convincing answer, then vote for the one that sounds most true. Each vote: +150. Most votes: +400. Ballots are never shown.
game.bluff.rules.house.title: House lies
game.bluff.rules.house.body: With few players, the game adds its own lies. Don't fall for them!
game.bluff.rules.same.title: Same lie?
game.bluff.rules.same.body: It shows once and the authors share the points.
game.bluff.rules.host.title: Host
game.bluff.rules.host.body: The host can skip a prompt or hide an answer; if the host hides the real one, the prompt is cancelled and nobody scores on it.
game.bluff.coach.roundIntro: New round, new way to lie. Read the rule on the card.
game.bluff.coach.writing: Write a lie that sounds true. Same shape as the hint.
game.bluff.coach.voting: Pick the answer you believe. Never your own.
game.bluff.coach.scores: Points so far. The final can change everything.
game.bluff.coach.results: Play again, or pick another game.
game.bluff.pause.endGameConfirm: End the game now? Scores so far go to the awards.
